mission: Re-pin the SNKR verification component after PR #180: PR #180 delivered SNKRDUNK auto-v1 discovery to the snkrdunk collector as ff019569478f570af9e82018fc69e81853508e85, but PR #179 merged a manifest that still pinned snkr_component to a504e47, so Verify staging merge of 406065306de1 failed on the five snkrdunk files #180 changed. This mission only declares the installed component (ff01956) and records the pin in the SNKR recovery note. No code, collector, schedule, setting, data, secret or Railway change; no collector rollout; no runbook run.

impacts.reason: Records that snkr_component must stay pinned to ff01956 (the #180 rollout) until the next snkrdunk rollout, and why the #179 merge verification failed.
